title: 皐月賞の後に・負けてもほのぼの

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Completely spent, Meisho Doto collapses on the turf.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Doto. Is that your impression of a soldier defeated by exhaustion? You appeared a little wilted during the race.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yeeeeah… I couldn't focus on anything but running, not even the results…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her loss to T.M. Opera O, Meisho Doto is able to clear her first hurdle in the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'd like to give you my thanks. I'm extremely flawed and clumsy… I thought the Classics might ruin me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But, at least I can say I got through it without bothering anyone. This was really a race to remember.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you. Um… but it would be nice to do something else for the occasion.
choice_data_list: Do you want to take a commemorative picture?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: No, that's not it… I'm thinking of having some snacks on a nice patch of grass. The breeze is nice today.
choice_data_list: You want to go on a trip?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Gyah! No, that's not what I meant!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
choice_data_list: It's fine, but we can't stay out too long.
It's fine, but we can't stay out too long.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Thank you so much. I'll invite everyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As one can imagine, not everyone agrees to come along. Still, we enjoy a little picnic sitting at the center of the track.
